title: The Four Days and the Five Faces
description: The Lord's going-forth articulated as four great days, each holding a twelvefold completeness, met against four nights of the self's forming (T4). The five faces by which the Lord approaches the soul — Divine Human, Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Great Counsel — met against five counterparts the self has organized as it sets up its mirror against influx (T5). Together: the structural extension of the divine outgoing the seeker is now navigating.
